title: Touhou Koumakyou ~ the Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil - Battle Spirit Of The Devil's Guardian 🐲 ~ Shanghai Alice of Meiji 17 (Remix)
description:
❝ Relying on projectiles is a waste.
Smacking them directly feels better. ❞
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ- Hong Meiling, 2009

Did an arrangement of Shanghai Alice of Meiji 17 from Touhou 6: Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil. Was recommended this one by a friend a week back and decided it'd be fun to do. Also, I'm also a MASSIVE Hong Meiling, and I think she's just really cool (just like you... maybe)!!! :D

Really wanted to go for a more badass take on the magical theme 'cuz I thought it'd be fitting for her alongside referencing her other theme 'cuz I'm basically in love with that theme.

Important:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi, P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. B Minor w/ slight detune (Remix Pitch - Listening-Only)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. B Minor (Remix Pitch) [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ3. G# Minor (MIDI Pitch)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ4. C# Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. Enables the voice clip, but isn't compatible with SMW (Listening-Only)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. Disables the voice clip (SMW-Compatible) [turned on by default]
